answer: An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Because the cipher solution is checked at the oasis gate and logged, the kernel audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 23 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. The deposit is 40 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
